about: Every race by every subject, for Chron Jobs' nightly painting: one race and one subject a night, all its versions, each in a different style, into the Images app's gallery. In a subject's prompt, {folk} is replaced by the race's look and {architecture} by its buildings. Every look, building and subject is EXTRAPOLATED: Claudia's drafts from the race icons, for Ben to change. Edit freely; the job rereads this file each night.
finish: Set in the medieval fantasy world of Talasia. No text, no letters, no writing anywhere in the picture.

folk.Western: Western humans in medieval European dress of linen tunics, wool cloaks and leather boots
folk.Eastern: Eastern humans in layered silk robes
folk.Southern: dark-skinned Southern humans in brightly woven wraps and gold jewellery
folk.Northern: tall Northern humans with braided hair and beards, in fur cloaks and heavy wool
folk.Barbarian: broad, wild-haired, tattooed Barbarian humans in furs and leather, rowdy and good-humoured
folk.Byzantine: Byzantine humans in embroidered robes and gold-trimmed mantles
folk.Dwarves: stocky dwarves with long braided beards, in leather and iron
folk.Hobthrushes: hobthrushes, small folk a little shorter than humans, with pointed ears, shaggy hair, waistcoats and long clay pipes
folk.Gnomes: gnomes, small quick-handed folk with big noses and bright eyes, in leather aprons with tool belts
folk.High Elves: high elves, tall and pale with long pointed ears and long silver-blond hair, in flowing white and blue robes
folk.Wood Elves: wood elves, lithe, with pointed ears and braided auburn hair, in green and brown leathers
folk.Shade Elves: shade elves, dark-skinned elves with long pointed ears and long dark hair in a high topknot, in deep violet robes
folk.Orcs: orcs, big green-skinned folk with lower tusks and braided black hair, in bone and leather
folk.Goblins: goblins, small wiry green-skinned folk with huge bat-like ears and sharp toothy grins
folk.Trolls: trolls, towering and long-limbed, with grey-green skin, long pointed ears, big drooping noses and shaggy hair
folk.Ogres: ogres, enormous heavy-set brutes with thick hide, small eyes and tusks, in crude hides

architecture.Eastern: sweeping tiled roofs, red lacquered gates and tiered pagodas
architecture.Southern: thick-walled whitewashed buildings with domes and shaded courtyards
architecture.Northern: long timber halls with carved gables and turf roofs
architecture.Barbarian: rough log halls and palisades hung with hides and antlers
architecture.Byzantine: domes, gold mosaics and marble colonnades
architecture.Dwarves: massive carved stone halls and gates cut into the mountainside
architecture.Hobthrushes: snug crooked cottages with mossy roofs among gardens and hedgerows
architecture.Gnomes: workshops of brass and timber with crooked chimneys, waterwheels and pulleys
architecture.High Elves: slender white towers with silver spires and arching bridges
architecture.Wood Elves: dwellings woven into the boughs of huge ancient trees, linked by rope walkways
architecture.Shade Elves: dark violet stone halls lit by pale glowing crystals
architecture.Orcs: rough stone and timber strongholds hung with bone and hide banners
architecture.Goblins: ramshackle huts of scavenged wood piled crookedly on one another
architecture.Trolls: huge rough halls of unmortared boulders
architecture.Ogres: enormous crude huts of logs and boulders
